source_note: See data/wow_spells/README.md for the schema. Every entry's values are read live from its own WoW: Forever Wowhead spell tooltip (wowhead.com/forever/spell=<wowhead_spell_id>) unless "notes" says otherwise. Covers only the Retribution single-target rotation pieces reachable in an 11-point level-20 build, like the other class passes.
gaps: Icy Veins presents TWO real level-20 builds with no single one called definitively best: the PRIMARY build (catalogued here) trades a Retribution talent for 2 points in the Holy tree (Improved Holy Strike) plus a defensive Retribution pick (Deflection); an ALTERNATIVE all-Retribution build instead takes Benediction 5/5 + Conviction 3/5 + Seal of Command 1/1 (dropping Improved Holy Strike and Deflection entirely) to reach Seal of Command, described as dealing "slightly more damage" especially with Judgement on stunned targets. Seal of Command and Benediction's real values are NOT sourced in this pass -- only the primary build's pieces are.
Seal of the Crusader (used situationally per the real rotation, to apply a Judgement-amplifying debuff on long fights before switching back to Seal of Righteousness) not looked up.
Exorcism (situational vs Undead/Demons), Consecration (AoE, explicitly out of scope for single-target), Hammer of Justice, Blessing of Might/Kings, Devotion Aura, Holy Light not looked up.
"talents.holy" only includes the 1 talent actually taken in the primary build (Improved Holy Strike) -- the rest of that tree, and all of Protection, are not catalogued.
Improved Judgement and Conviction's exact numeric per-rank effects not looked up (only names/point allocation confirmed from the real build).

abilities.notes: Exactly the level-20 cap. Base 12-second cooldown; Improved Holy Strike (talented in the primary real build) reduces this. Real single-target priority (Icy Veins): use on cooldown alongside Judgement, whenever Mana allows.

Real, important mechanic: Judgement deals NO damage of its own -- it "unleashes the energy of your active Seal" without consuming it, so its actual effect comes entirely from whichever Seal ability's own entry is active (see paladin_seal_of_righteousness for the default single-target Seal). Costs a % of base Mana, not a flat amount. Uses no GCD, unlike almost every other ability catalogued in this project so far.

effects.description: Deals whatever damage/effect the currently active Seal's own "Judgement effect" specifies -- see the active Seal's own ability entry.

abilities.notes: Rank 3 is the max rank trainable by level 20 (Rank 4 requires level 26). Two distinct effects in one ability: (1) a passive buff, active for 30s, adding +6 to 20 Holy damage to every melee swing (explicitly weapon-speed-scaled: "slower weapons cause more Holy damage per swing" -- a real per-swing flat bonus, not a DPS-normalized one); (2) a separate 53-57 Holy damage direct hit dealt only when Judgement is cast while this Seal is active ("unleashing this Seal's energy"). Real, explicit tooltip rule: "Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time" -- another sourced non-stacking-across-sources rule, consistent with Serpent Sting's (Hunter) similar rule. Real single-target priority (Icy Veins): the default Seal to keep active unless Seal of Command is talented (not in this build).

effects.notes: scales with weapon speed: slower weapons get more bonus damage per swing

effects.description: When Judgement is cast while this Seal is active

retribution.effect_per_rank: +Parry chance per rank; Parries also speed up the next auto-attack ("Parry Haste"), per Icy Veins' text -- a small real DPS side-effect of what's primarily a defensive talent
retribution.notes: Real primary-build pick, 5/5. The guide explicitly says to swap this out for Benediction once past level 20 for group content.
